title: Code review
text: Open a pull request and ask one reviewer. Do not merge your own pull request. A review is required before the change reaches main.

title: Documentation
text: Write setup notes in the repo README, not in a personal message.

title: Documentation
text: A documentation change still needs one reviewer.

title: Equipment
text: The office manager assigns a desk on day one, next to your team.

title: Equipment
text: Return the laptop and badge to the office manager on your last day.

title: Expenses
text: A meal with a client is reimbursed up to 40 GEL. File the receipt within 10 days.

title: Expenses
text: Send the receipt to the office manager. Personal meals are not reimbursed.

title: First day
text: Arrive at 09:30. Collect your badge from the office manager.

title: First day
text: Your work email is created before you arrive. Sign in with that email.

title: Holidays
text: The company observes the public holidays of Georgia. The office is closed those days.

title: Holidays
text: Check the shared holiday calendar before you promise a deadline.

title: Incidents
text: Report a production incident in the #incidents channel the same day you see it.

title: Incidents
text: A site that is down is severity 1. A typo on an internal page is severity 3.

title: Leave balance
text: Full-time employees get 20 paid leave days per calendar year.

title: Leave balance
text: Those days are still requested in the HR form at least 5 working days ahead. Your manager approves the request.

title: Office hours
text: The office is open from 09:00 to 18:00 on weekdays.

title: Office hours
text: Two remote days a week are allowed after your first month. Tell your manager the day before.

title: Pairing
text: Pair on a change that touches authentication or payments.

title: Pairing
text: One person types and the other reviews the diff as you go. Open the pull request when you both agree.

title: Passwords
text: Use the company password manager. Do not send a password in Slack.

title: Passwords
text: Ask the office manager to reset a work account. Do not share your password with a teammate.

title: Slack
text: Use #general for announcements and #help for questions a handbook page might answer.

title: Slack
text: Do not expect a reply after 18:00. Urgent production issues go to #incidents.

title: Standups
text: The team standup is at 10:00 on weekdays and lasts 15 minutes.

title: Standups
text: Say what you finished, what you are doing today, and what is blocked.

title: Laptop
text: New hires collect a laptop from the office manager on day one. Sign in with your work email. Lost laptop reports go to the office manager the same day.

title: Time off
text: To request time off, file a request in the HR form at least 5 working days ahead. Your manager approves it. Sick time off can be filed the same day.
